model_annotation: This figure presents two line plots comparing the training reward performance of two reinforcement learning methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on Easy and Hard training sets, respectively. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100, and the same y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” scaled from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot (“Easy Training Set”), the blue line with circular markers (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.2 around step 150, then gradually declines to about 0.1 by step 500. The red line with square markers (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) follows a similar trend, beginning near 0.0, peaking slightly above 0.2 around step 200, and decreasing to approximately 0.1 at step 500. In the bottom plot (“Hard Training Set”), the blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts near 0.0, dips slightly below 0.0 before rising to about 0.05 around step 100, then declines steadily to near 0.0 by step 500. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) begins near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.08 around step 100, and then fluctuates with a general downward trend, ending near 0.03 at step 500. Both plots include shaded regions around each line, likely representing standard deviation or confidence intervals.
